itineraries.title: Five days from Corfu to Paxos
itineraries.intro: Corfu’s north-east coast and the Paxos islets.

days.note: The old town between its two forts; board and sail south for the first swim.
Gaios harbour behind its islets; the west coast caves by tender.
Anchor at Voutoumi for the whitest sand and clearest water in the Ionian.
The Venetian castle above the town and the beach at Valtos.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Corfu to Zakynthos
itineraries.intro: The Ionian from north to south, green islands and short hops.

days.note: Board in Corfu; the old town.
Gaios harbour behind its islets; the west coast caves by tender.
The Venetian castle above the town and the beach at Valtos.
Lefkada’s sheltered inlets and the waterfalls behind the village.
The Venetian houses of the harbour and the anchorages of the strait.
Vathy at the head of its deep bay; the walk to Homer’s spring.
